items.question: How do I extract a Douyin video transcript in one click?
items.answer: After collecting the Douyin video with MediaClaw, trigger transcript extraction right on the record; the voiceover turns to text in place. No video download, no ad-walled mini-program, and no jumping between tools.

items.question: What are the timestamps for?
items.answer: Timestamps reveal a video's pacing and logic. Flat text only tells you what was said; a timestamped script tells you when the hook is thrown, how long the setup drags, where the turn lands, and how it closes, which is what you need to read a benchmark script's structure.

items.question: Can I batch-extract transcripts for a set of Douyin videos?
items.answer: Yes. For volume, use the Feishu base audio/video-to-text field shortcut with Alibaba Bailian; drop the raw links into the table and it extracts row by row, with 10 free hours a month, about 300 clips at two minutes each. The extension also extracts row by row on records.

items.question: Do I need Feishu to extract transcripts in the extension?
items.answer: No. The raw data lives inside the extension, so you trigger extraction on the record and the result writes back there, ready to copy or export as CSV/Markdown. Feishu is an optional path for batch and sync when volume is high.
